dct_description_sm:
Polygons delimiting Montreal's electoral basins, i.e. basins presenting the sections served by the same voting location.

Several [related data sets] (https://donnees.montreal.ca/search?q=tags:%C3%89lections) are available for the 2021 Montreal municipal election.

More information on the 2021 elections in Montreal on the [portal] (https://elections.montreal.ca/fr/) provided for this purpose.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
